children.text: The live MPD panel needs the DSH Go local engine bridge. This static view is what renders without it.

items.title: Approve the staged team plan
items.subtitle: Activates the plan's members and tasks in this workspace.

items.title: Run one dispatch pass
items.subtitle: Pairs every ready task with its owner so the work can start.

items.title: Answer a pending question
items.subtitle: Replies to the open question so the waiting member can continue.

children.text: Slots are served by the local engine only, so a relay or SSH host shows tool cards instead of this panel.
